name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by late-night broadcasts in Japan. After graduating with a degree in Marketing from Waseda University, he initially worked for a consumer electronics company, honing his skills in brand management and digital marketing. However, his passion for racing never waned, leading him to pursue a career in motorsport. He joined Stewart-Haas Racing five years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to their marketing strategies.

Kenji's approach is data-driven and customer-centric, focusing on building authentic connections with fans and sponsors. He is adept at leveraging social media and digital platforms to enhance brand visibility and engagement. He is known for his ability to adapt marketing campaigns to resonate with diverse audiences and for his meticulous attention to detail. 

What sets Kenji apart is his deep understanding of both Japanese and American business cultures, allowing him to bridge the gap between global sponsors and the team's marketing objectives. He is a firm believer in the power of storytelling and is committed to crafting compelling narratives that capture the excitement and drama of racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and wears rectangular-framed glasses.

Drinks green tea throughout the day
Has a habit of meticulously organizing his desk at the end of each workday
